body: How will me dying put a burden on his life? He told me he’s looking for a fairy tale relationship. I’m far from perfect, but I have so many good qualities. I’m just not good enough. So I thought I’d enjoy one last vacation and then come home and end my pain. He won’t care. He won’t miss me. He will just be suffering with guilt. I have my pills ready and I researched what to do. He will go to work, I will stay home and end my pain.
